D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, James Byrd runs furthest behind in Crook, Lincoln, Washakie. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: Moderates, 15% of voters, 43 to 57, where a 5 point gain is worth 0.75 points; Health care and Social Security voters, 11% of voters, 44 to 56, where a 5 point gain is worth 0.56 points; 2024 nonvoters and third party voters, 10% of voters, 45 to 55, where a 5 point gain is worth 0.52 points.
